title: Weigh a Solid
description: Use an analytical balance to collect reproducible mass evidence.

title: Measure Liquid Volume
description: Measure a fixed liquid volume using a calibrated cylinder.

title: Make a Solution
description: Dissolve a weighed solid in solvent and track concentration state.

title: Dilute a Stock Solution
description: Create a target dilution from an aliquot and final volume.

title: Transfer Liquid
description: Move a measured liquid volume between containers without overflow.

title: Filter a Precipitate
description: Collect a precipitate with filter paper, rinse it, and preserve evidence.

title: Dry and Weigh a Precipitate
description: Dry a precipitate to stable mass and record the calculation evidence.

title: Calculate Hardness
description: Calculate mg/L hardness as CaCO3 from precipitate mass and sample volume.
